scope: Actual authenticated chat composition using existing application, context, provider, conversation and product owners

interfaces.model_selection: Optional exact registered provider/model selection is bound into the admitted execution context policy before dispatch; arbitrary models, credential transports and silent fallback on explicit selection reject
interfaces.generation: Optional validated temperature is provider-neutral configuration; token output limits remain in admitted resource budgets
interfaces.stream: Actual provider text deltas publish bounded provisional events through the existing execution repository; canonical assistant messages are committed only from the final governed result
interfaces.replay: Additive execution event journal preserves immutable sequence, digest and stable event identity; after_sequence acknowledges the last accepted event and durable reads survive process restart
interfaces.conversation: Authorized server-owned threads, active lineage, revisions, search/archive/delete, pending turns and terminal assistant receipts reconstruct product state; local drafts are rebuildable cache only
interfaces.attachments: Explicit rights and current conversation scope admit bounded actual extracted file evidence as untrusted context through existing owners
interfaces.readiness: Catalog projects configured declared provider availability and safe diagnostics; unavailable local artifacts never produce fabricated models or hosted fallback

failure: Invalid selection, stale execution identity, event gaps/corruption, withdrawn conversation/attachments, deadline/cancellation and unavailable providers fail explicitly; provisional text never becomes verified evidence by being rendered
rollback: Disable new chat surfaces while preserving existing conversation/execution state and event journal; do not erase history or enable direct backend provider calls
